summary: Iteration 103: Verified multi-day holiday calendar events + overtime holiday deduction integration. 8/8 backend tests pass. Frontend calendar modal and workload sheet verified visually.

ui_bugs.issue: Sheet header line does not display holiday count (e.g. 'أيام الإجازات الرسمية: 2'). The Excel export correctly includes this text in row 2 header, but the on-screen header only shows period dates and total_weeks. Review request explicitly expected 'header line shows holiday count' in tw-view-sheet.

action_items: Add holiday_days to OvertimeSheet.tsx header: when period.holiday_days > 0, render e.g. ` · أيام الإجازات الرسمية: {period.holiday_days}` next to عدد الأسابيع. The backend already returns period.holiday_days and holidays[].
critical_code_review_comments: calendar_events.py _check_end validates end-date format via _gregorian_to_hijri which raises 400 on invalid — good.
holiday_dates expands multi-day ranges correctly using date iteration.
RBAC: all write endpoints call _can_manage (manage_calendar permission); admin passes via has_permission.

success_rate.frontend: verified (modal end-date-input appears when إجازة selected; seeded range displayed as '2026-09-07 ← 2026-09-08'; sheet view shows 'إجازة رسمية 1.5 س (إجازة تجريبية)' notes for بلاغة-2 rows for أحمد بن سميط, and no holiday deduction for executed lecture of عبدالله باوزير)

seed_data_creation: None preserved; test created events are deleted at end of each test. Seeded holiday 'إجازة تجريبية' (2026-09-07→08) and seed_ot teachers were not modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_holidays_overtime_iter103.py (uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env). To re-run: export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... && pytest backend/tests/test_holidays_overtime_iter103.py. Teachers field name is 'course_name' (not course_code) in the workload row response. Shortfall field is 'shortfall_hours'. Teacher list fields: 'teacher_name'/'courses'. Only remaining UI gap is holiday-count header on the on-screen sheet.
rca of the issue: Missing holiday-count on sheet header: OvertimeSheet.tsx line 39 constructs the sub-header string from period.start_date/end_date/total_weeks only — ignores period.holiday_days. Fix: append ` · أيام الإجازات الرسمية: {period.holiday_days}` when > 0, matching Excel export format.
